name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP cuts Sudan and Gaza aid; no full suspension
summary: WFP says 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food aid over funding cuts and it has ended monthly aid to 500,000 in Gaza
state: WFP said on 12 Nov that funding shortfalls cut the number it reaches in Sudan from over 4 million in August to just over 3 million, leaving about 900,000 without food aid, and that it needs $520 million through April 2027 (Sudan Tribune). WFP cut aid to 500,000 people in Gaza in October over funding shortages (Al Jazeera, 19 Oct). Major ration cuts meet Watch; no large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country was found as of 20 Nov.
for_you: Aid cuts fall on people in crisis zones and tend to raise malnutrition and onward migration over the following months.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP Sudan caseload cut by about 900,000; Gaza 500,000); no pipeline-wide suspension found

sources.title: Sudan Tribune — WFP chief urges end to Sudan fighting as funding cuts leave 900,000 without food aid
Al Jazeera — WFP cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza amid funding shortages

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
